title: dodecatheon meadia var. jeffreyi
intro: Dodecatheon meadia var. jeffreyi, commonly known as Western Pasque Flower, is a perennial plant species in the gentian family. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and support immune function. The plant's therapeutic actions are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties. Additionally, the Western Pasque Flower has been traditionally used to treat respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant properties.
